svg.title: How IBM counts IBM MQ and IBM Integration
svg.desc: How IBM counts it, in three columns. Self-managed MQ: Processor Value Units, as a perpetual license, or Virtual Processor Cores, monthly; the same VPC metric hourly through IBM Cloud. MQ as a Service: Capacity Units, monthly, based on the Cloud Services capacity type you select. IBM Integration: Usage-based credits as SaaS; entitlement-based licensing as self-managed software.
